name: mcp-eval-mode-hardening
title: MCP eval mode: ground-truth wall, auth interaction, docs
description: Keep scoring rubric off the agent-facing surface: MCP tools must never expose anomalies.csv, /v1/anomalies, or /v1/scenarios; define bearer-auth and rate-limit interaction for /mcp; document the eval loop (agent on /mcp, harness holds anomalies.csv) in README/CLAUDE.md.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Audit sweep found a load-bearing leak: metric_report.log is a verbatim rendering of anomalies.csv (same descriptions, event_ids, Cascading: labels). The phase-2 get_logs/deduplicate_logs MCP tools read it, and /v1/logs/stream streams it — all handed an agent the answer key. Eval mode now hides the log stream + refuses the two log tools, plus /v1/anomalies, /v1/scenarios, /v1/state, /v1/debug/*, and the console shell, via one _rubric_endpoint registry with a source-scanning completeness test. Chose 404 over 403 for fingerprint-resistance. Follow-up worth considering: a distinct symptom-level observable log artifact that eval mode could serve (the current report log cannot be, by construction).
